name: discount-cap
goal: Discounts above 100 percent made invoice totals negative

name: refund-over-captured
goal: Refunding a payment for more than was captured reached the gateway before being rejected

name: aging-due-today
goal: Invoices due today were listed as overdue in the aging report

name: requeue-attempts
goal: Jobs whose lease expired were requeued without counting the failed attempt

name: backoff-overflow
goal: Retry delay panicked with a shift overflow after many attempts

name: percentile-rank
goal: Latency percentile picked the wrong sample for small sets

name: retry-after-date
goal: Retry-After headers given as a date were ignored

name: cache-key-order
goal: The same request with parameters in a different order missed the response cache

name: token-skew
goal: Refresh access tokens shortly before they expire instead of after
